objective: Make Elf Vault the only personal credential and autofill authority used by Magic Browser while keeping raw values inside the trusted extension executor and enforcing fail-closed privacy after fill.

nodes.title: Semantic vault model
nodes.objective: Persist semantic item kinds, creation-path metadata, provenance, the shared ImportResult contract, and complete login, identity, address, payment, government, and financial roles with backward-compatible serialization and conservative risk metadata.
nodes.deliverable: Old records still deserialize; new and template-created records persist kind, roles, transaction-only markers, provenance, and role-derived release class; the shared ImportResult contract contains counts and loss entries without raw-value disclosure.
proof: padloc changed-only core model round trips
compatibility fixture for missing item kind
role and risk table has no secret-bearing output

nodes.title: 1PUX migration
nodes.objective: Consume the shared ImportProvenance/ImportResult contract, normalize 1PUX records into semantic roles, and return an exact loss report for unsupported data.
nodes.deliverable: Synthetic 1PUX fixtures consume the shared contract, produce normalized items with persisted provenance, imported/normalized/skipped/lossy counts, and explicit unsupported-category warnings without claiming passkey migration.
proof: no real export or secret fixture

nodes.title: Passkey migration contract
nodes.objective: Implement explicit relying-party re-enrollment and verified assertion flow without copying or removing working credentials, including the passkey-owned background orchestration region before the G005 handoff.
nodes.deliverable: Re-enrollment and assertion use exact RP/origin/flow/TTL bindings and recent verification; the passkey background region is frozen for a serial G005 handoff; 1PUX never reports passkeys migrated and existing factors remain untouched.
proof: binding, expiry, lock, stale-verification, and wrong-RP negative cases
passkey background-region handoff and regression fixture

nodes.title: Approval and unlock policy
nodes.objective: Complete conservative approval modes, exact standing policies, revocation, lock behavior, and fresh verification for high-risk roles.
nodes.deliverable: Plan/manual/auto/dontAsk/bypassPrompts, hard deny, always-ask, missing authority, revisioned revocation, lock, expiry, online authority, and high-risk fresh verification all fail closed correctly.
proof: every approval mode and reason code
payment, CVV, government, financial, passkey, new-origin, and policy-change step-up cases

nodes.title: Trusted extension execution
nodes.objective: Keep values inside Elf Vault, strengthen the native broker and trusted executor, own the exact privacy-status state machine/reset, and return only closed redacted plans, privacy state, and receipts.
nodes.deliverable: Classify, plan, approve, mint, apply, revoke, and privacy-status operate through the extension-owned executor with exact target revalidation, one-value-at-a-time resolution, a trusted reset, an exact target descriptor, ciphertext-only compatibility import, and closed redacted responses.
proof: broker protocol and native-host redaction tests
privacy state/reset and descriptor mismatch negatives
TTL, nonce, revocation, lock, worker restart, and nested secret-key rejection

nodes.title: Magic Browser broker cutover
nodes.objective: Make the Padloc native broker the standard personal autofill path, constrain the local vault to an opaque encrypted-profile migration or synthetic fixtures, and enforce closed response parsing.
nodes.deliverable: Standard autofill plan/apply/proof commands call Padloc native broker and never mint local authority; compatibility migration sends only the encrypted envelope, closed response parsing rejects unknown keys, and direct CLI screenshots use the already-proven shared gate.
proof: CLI call-site tests prove no standard command loads local vault authority
native/CDP closed-schema response redaction and protocol-v1 compatibility tests
ciphertext-only compatibility migration and unavailable-key negative fixtures

nodes.title: Magic Browser privacy gate
nodes.objective: Own a named shared observation gate, make snapshots metadata-only, and centrally block every generic model-observation primitive after a document becomes potentially private while preserving redacted proof.
nodes.deliverable: The named shared gate checks exact Padloc tab/frame/document/form/revision state before snapshots, evidence, page text/accessibility, screenshots, image reads, eval, and network/body capture; input values are absent from snapshots before and after fill; unknown and private states fail closed.
proof: shared gate and metadata-only snapshot unit tests for clean, unknown, private, new-document, tab-close, and reset
pre-fill and post-fill open_snapshot/compact snapshot redaction cases
typed-worker, bridge, screenshot, network, body, and guarded-eval integration cases

nodes.title: Cross-repository contract proof
nodes.objective: Align role vocabulary, protocol-v1 compatibility, privacy state, redaction, and proof authority across both repositories.
nodes.deliverable: Both repositories consume the same synthetic contract fixtures and the existing proof authority has exact command keys or an explicit UNKNOWN result.
proof: proof authority check with exact candidate SHA recorded at execution time

nodes.title: Synthetic end-to-end proof
nodes.objective: Exercise the complete fake-data native-host and browser flow, including privacy enforcement, revocation, lock, and service-worker restart.
nodes.deliverable: One deterministic smoke exits non-zero on any raw-value leak, target mismatch, privacy bypass, stale grant, or restart failure and stores redacted evidence only.
proof: stdout, logs, argv, screenshots, and artifacts contain no raw values

nodes.title: Operator and pilot documentation
nodes.objective: Publish exact diagnostics, migration warnings, security boundaries, and a synthetic-first limited real-data pilot sequence.
nodes.deliverable: Operator diagnostics and pilot runbook match the proven command surface, list unsupported migration categories, and keep real-data entry gated after synthetic proof.
